issues.detail:
Achievable now: We can build an original open-world driving and action game inspired by GTA with realistic movement, maps, missions and character controls.
Honest scope note: Full 3D graphics and complex physics will need advanced libraries or engines not covered here.
Step 1 — Basic Game World & Player Movement
  goal: A top-down view of a city map where player can move a car using arrow keys
  build: Create a basic HTML5 canvas-based game with a static grid-map background representing streets. Add keyboard-controlled player vehicle movement (up/down/left/right) that stays within map boundaries. Use simple colored rectangles for visuals. Must run fully in browser without external servers or asset hosting.
Step 2 — NPC Traffic & Basic Obstacles
  goal: Other cars moving automatically on roads, player can collide with them
  build: Add non-player vehicles moving along preset paths on the main roads. Implement collision detection between player and NPC cars which stops movement temporarily. Include visual indicators when collisions happen. Keep everything running client-side in browser.
Step 3 — Missions & Score System
  goal: Pick-up missions marked on map with point scoring on completion
  build: Place mission markers (flags or icons) on specific locations on map. When player reaches marker, show simple objective like 'deliver package'. On completing task by reaching destination zone, update score display. Store high scores locally using browser storage.
Step 4 — Weapons & Combat Mechanics
  goal: Player can shoot enemies and destroy vehicles with projectiles
  build: Implement mouse-click based shooting mechanic from player position towards cursor direction. Add enemy characters who take damage when hit. Show visual effects for hits/explosions. Allow destruction of vehicles with enough hits. All logic handled in-browser.
Step 5 — Radio Stations & Sound Effects
  goal: Background music synced with gameplay actions and ambient sounds
  build: Integrate audio playback for background radio tracks that loop during play. Add sound triggers for events like engine start, gunshots, crashes. Provide volume controls and ability to mute/unmute. Run entirely through web audio APIs.
Step 6 — Advanced Physics & Multiplayer Mode [infra ceiling]
  goal: Realistic vehicle handling and online multiplayer racing mode
  build: Implement gravity, acceleration/deceleration curves, drifting mechanics for better realism. Enable WebSocket connections for multiple players to join same game session from different devices. Requires backend support for syncing positions across clients.
